description: NaV₅O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.64 Å) and three longer (2.65 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-50°. There are four shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.09 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.26 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.25 Å. In the fourth V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are four shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.09 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the fifth V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.20 Å. In the sixth V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.21 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to five V atoms to form distorted OV₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with five OV₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five V atoms to form distorted OV₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with five OV₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four V atoms to form OV₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with four ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four V atoms to form OV₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three OV₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with four ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven OV₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with four ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven OV₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with four OV₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids.
